description: analogRead on A0, A5, A6 and A7 of the Nano (A6 and A7 are analog-only inputs), with the default and the internal reference.
basis: ATmega328P datasheet 24.7: ADC = floor(Vin * 1024 / Vref) limited to 1023, Vref = VCC (5 V) for DEFAULT and 1.1 V for INTERNAL; the eightanaloginputs variant of the core has eight analog inputs (A6 = 20, A7 = 21, ADC channels 6 and 7); computed by hand: 2.51 V -> 514, 4 V -> 819, 0.612 V -> 125 (DEFAULT) and 569 (INTERNAL), 1.5 V -> 307
